scope.description: Five-node in-process scenario with the corrected selective delivery; the after_sync event now also records node 5's leader view, phase flag and promise ballot and node 2's phase flag.
assumptions: Messages are delivered only along the routes each step names; withheld messages stay queued until delivered or dropped.
No ticks are called, so leadership is obtained only through try_become_leader.
excluded: Snapshots, flexible quorums, batching, reconfiguration and multiple delayed promises.

basis.prefix: Identical to the previous run: decide Value(1..=4) everywhere; append Value(5), deliver its AcceptDecide to 2,3,5 and drop it for 4, deliver the Accepteds to node 1, deliver the Decide only to node 5; emit ready. Cut node 1, elect node 2 with promises from 3 and 4 only, hold node 2's Prepare for node 5, deliver the AcceptSyncs to 3 and 4 and hold their Accepted replies. Deliver the held Prepare, deliver node 5's Promise to node 2, deliver node 2's AcceptSync to node 5, then emit late_sync phase=after_sync with decided, decided_before, entry_status, decided_leader2, regressed, n5_leader_pid, n5_accept, n5_promise_n, n5_promise_pid and n2_accept. Then deliver the held Accepted replies, settle among nodes 2..5, and emit after_redecide.

comparisons.description: After the AcceptSync, node 5's decided index is lower than before.

before.description: Same five-node in-process scenario with corrected delivery control: entry 5 is accepted by 1,2,3,5 and the Decide reaches only node 5; node 1 is then cut, node 2 is elected with promises from 3 and 4 only, and node 5 promises after that quorum. No settle pass runs between the selective steps, so node 2 must still be decided=4 when node 5 promises.
assumptions: Messages are delivered synchronously only along the routes each step names; withheld messages stay in the queue and are either delivered deliberately or dropped.
Holding the Accepted(5) replies from nodes 3 and 4 models slow acknowledgement, not corruption.
No ticks are called, so leadership is obtained only through try_become_leader.
excluded: Snapshots, flexible quorums, batching, reconfiguration and multiple delayed promises.

after.description: Five-node in-process scenario with the corrected selective delivery; the after_sync event now also records node 5's leader view, phase flag and promise ballot and node 2's phase flag.
assumptions: Messages are delivered only along the routes each step names; withheld messages stay queued until delivered or dropped.
No ticks are called, so leadership is obtained only through try_become_leader.
excluded: Snapshots, flexible quorums, batching, reconfiguration and multiple delayed promises.

prefix.before: Build nodes 1..5 (ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2,3,4,5]}, MemoryStorage) and settle. node1.try_become_leader(); settle. Append Value(1..=4) with settle after each. Append Value(5); collect and deliver its AcceptDecide to nodes 2,3 and 5 while dropping the one addressed to node 4 (purged from the queue); collect the Accepted(5) replies and deliver them to node 1; collect node 1's Decide for index 5 and deliver it only to node 5. Emit ready (phase=before, node=5, decided, entry status at index 4, leader1 decided, node2 decided and accepted). Purge all traffic touching node 1, call node2.try_become_leader(), hold node 2's Prepare addressed to node 5, collect and deliver the promises from nodes 3 and 4 so node 2 reaches Accept, collect and deliver its AcceptSync to nodes 3 and 4, then collect and hold their Accepted(5) replies. Deliver the held Prepare to node 5, collect and deliver its Promise to node 2, collect and deliver node 2's AcceptSync to node 5. Emit late_sync phase=after_sync. Deliver the held Accepted(5) replies to node 2 and settle among nodes 2..5; emit late_sync phase=after_redecide.
prefix.after: Identical to the previous run: decide Value(1..=4) everywhere; append Value(5), deliver its AcceptDecide to 2,3,5 and drop it for 4, deliver the Accepteds to node 1, deliver the Decide only to node 5; emit ready. Cut node 1, elect node 2 with promises from 3 and 4 only, hold node 2's Prepare for node 5, deliver the AcceptSyncs to 3 and 4 and hold their Accepted replies. Deliver the held Prepare, deliver node 5's Promise to node 2, deliver node 2's AcceptSync to node 5, then emit late_sync phase=after_sync with decided, decided_before, entry_status, decided_leader2, regressed, n5_leader_pid, n5_accept, n5_promise_n, n5_promise_pid and n2_accept. Then deliver the held Accepted replies, settle among nodes 2..5, and emit after_redecide.

before.description: After the AcceptSync, node 5's decided index is lower than before and the entry at index 4 reads undecided.
After the new leader re-decides, node 5 is back at decided 5, so the same entry was observed decided, undecided and decided again.

after.description: After the AcceptSync, node 5's decided index is lower than before.

revision_reason: Same scenario and delivery control as the previous run, plus diagnostic fields at the after_sync sample: node 5's current leader pid and Accept flag, node 5's promise ballot number and pid, and node 2's Accept flag. These distinguish a missing/rejected AcceptSync from an applied one.
